actualPersistedJournal.text: I accepted ordinary background sounds in a quiet moment.

sourceCorrelationOnly.title: The quiet place has noises
sourceCorrelationOnly.setupTemplate: You sit somewhere quiet and immediately notice a clock, a distant door and somebody clearing their throat. Apparently quiet did not mean perfectly silent.

selectedChoice.label: Let the ordinary sounds be there
selectedChoice.title: Quiet enough is available
selectedChoice.result: You stop checking each sound for a reason to be irritated. The place becomes restful without becoming silent.

actualPersistedJournal.text: I corrected an assumption about what I do with my time.

sourceCorrelationOnly.title: Apparently your days are free
sourceCorrelationOnly.setupTemplate: A stranger asks how you fill your time now that you are retired. They have not asked what your current situation actually is.

selectedChoice.label: Give the accurate short answer
selectedChoice.title: The assumption receives an update
selectedChoice.result: You explain your current situation plainly. They look slightly embarrassed at having supplied it for you.
selectedChoice.journal: I corrected an assumption about what I do with my time.

actualPersistedJournal.text: I spent a short wait noticing what was around me.

sourceCorrelationOnly.title: A minute without filling it
sourceCorrelationOnly.setupTemplate: You have a short wait with nothing to do. Before reaching for a distraction, you notice you have already checked the same screen three times.

selectedChoice.label: Look around for a minute
selectedChoice.title: The world supplies a few details
selectedChoice.result: You notice a small sign and an interesting pattern of light. The wait becomes a moment rather than a gap to erase.
selectedChoice.journal: I spent a short wait noticing what was around me.

actualPersistedJournal.text: I stopped comparing ordinary meals with a staged picture.

sourceCorrelationOnly.title: A picture is not a meal plan

selectedChoice.label: Remember the picture has a different purpose
selectedChoice.title: Lunch is allowed to look ordinary
selectedChoice.result: You stop treating a staged picture as a daily requirement. Your food does not need professional lighting to count.
